description: This file is a test automation script for the Vitest testing framework, involving lock management, child process handling, and test specification creation.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures the lock is released only once during script execution.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes temporary include files specified in the test run specification.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a provided Vitest specification, managing process output and cleanup.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates the default test run specification for the root project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that orchestrates test execution, lock management, and process control.
